notes.subject: פרצו
notes.rationale: 'They break out (like a flood)' vs 'break all bounds' — Infinitives Absolute read as verbs or nouns.

notes.subject: ודמים בדמים
notes.rationale: Repetition 'blood touches blood' — bloodshed upon bloodshed — kept literal as 'blut i tekim blut'.

notes.subject: אלה
notes.rationale: Read as noun 'cursing' rather than verb 'swearing falsely'; both ancient options.

translation: Ol i sutim tok kasten, na ol i giaman, na ol i kilim man, na ol i stilim, na ol i slak wantaim meri bilong narapela; ol i brukim olgeta banis, na blut i tekim blut.

tokens.gloss: na slak wantaim meri bilong narapela
